Pete Hegseth has authorized an expanded National Guard presence in Washington, D.C., including military vehicles, police cars and boats. 
Troops will support police operations targeting drug traffickers and gangs but cannot make arrests or pursue suspects. 
The expansion will remain in place through the end of 2026, while the broader deployment is expected to continue until January 2029.
Source: POLITICO
